scope: Checkpoint rights only: local noncommercial evaluation and publication of aggregate metrics. BCI Arena does not distribute weights, embeddings, or learned heads. This is issue spotting, not legal advice.

code_license.scope_note: Root LICENSE applies to the repository's 'Software'.

checkpoint_license.authorship: Weibang Jiang authored the official 'Upload checkpoints' commit; the README cites Wei-Bang Jiang, Li-Ming Zhao, and Bao-Liang Lu for LaBraM.
checkpoint_license.release_or_card: GitHub Releases API returned []; no separate checkpoint card or release terms were linked from the official README.
checkpoint_license.finding: The official maintainer committed labram-base.pth inside the MIT-licensed repository and the README instructs users to load and fine-tune it. Reading the repository license as covering the committed checkpoint is reasonable, although there is no separate weight-specific license statement.

aggregate_noncommercial_evaluation.reason: No research-only, noncommercial, field-of-use, or reporting restriction was found. Local inference and publishing independently generated aggregate metrics do not redistribute the checkpoint, embeddings, or heads. Residual risk is the unexpressed scope of the repository license, not a found prohibition.

code_license.scope_note: The GitHub source repository has an Apache-2.0 LICENSE.

checkpoint_license.authorship: The official repository identifies the NeurIPS 2024 paper; the official proceedings list Guagnyu Wang, Wenchao Liu, Yuhong He, Cong Xu, Lin Ma, and Haifeng Li. Figshare item authorship was not retrievable.
checkpoint_license.metadata_attempt: The official README exposes private-share token e37df4f8a907a866df4b. A metadata-only HEAD to the official downloader confirmed file ID 46452745 and the exact filename, but returned no article ID. The share page returned an AWS WAF challenge (HTTP 202/empty body) and the official /v2/articles/search request returned HTTP 403. Because no article ID was observed, /v2/articles/<id> could not be queried without guessing.
checkpoint_license.finding: The repository Apache-2.0 license covers code, while the checkpoint is hosted as a separate Figshare private-share object. No affirmative checkpoint license or Figshare authorship metadata was obtained. Tokenized download access does not establish reuse rights.

aggregate_noncommercial_evaluation.reason: No express restriction was observed, but absence of an observed restriction is not a grant. Aggregate-only publication avoids redistribution but does not resolve authority to use the checkpoint.
